annotator_instructions: Fill one entry per target from the SNES-01 video/frames. Boxes are full-res source pixels [x, y, w, h], origin top-left. event_window_s bounds the visible removal interval in whole seconds (t=N-1 rule). source_box_xywh marks where the part sat (source_frame = a pre-removal frame showing it); destination_box_xywh marks where it was deposited (destination_frame, or null when never visibly deposited). disposition: 'distinct' (a careful reviewer can identify this instance) or 'ambiguous' (instances indistinguishable, e.g. membranes). Set status to 'sealed', fill annotator + annotated_date, and freeze the file before scoring. This template ships with nulls only; it is not ground truth.
